note: King 一样是围绕轮换制国王剧情的 NPC,针对当天在位的国王吐槽,7 句吐槽对应 7 位轮换国王角色(见 King.json 的 aliases)。

messages.context: 当值国王是 Grandan 时的吐槽
messages.gloss: 暗示 Grandan 是她最不喜欢的国王(7 位里排第 7,垫底)。
messages.zh: Grandan 是我第7喜欢的国王。

messages.context: 当值国王是 Thormyr 时的吐槽
messages.text: Thormyr only sleeps and eats when he's not at this table. Nothing else.
messages.zh: Thormyr 不在这张桌子边的时候就只会睡觉和吃东西,别的什么都不做。
messages.raw: §fThormyr only sleeps and eats when he's not at this table. Nothing else.

messages.context: 当值国王是 Brammor 时的吐槽,含疑似拼写错误/矮人口音词
messages.gloss: 'Norry'、'zbells' 疑似矮人口音的非标准拼写(推测本意接近 'Sorry, Brammor smells too bad.'),按原文逐字采集,翻译阶段需要人工判断怎么处理这种口音变形词,不要自行'纠正'成标准英语再翻译。 译文用"报歉"(抱歉的同音误写)和"辣"(啦的同音误写)两处小typo模拟原文Norry/zbells的口音变形效果,不追求逐字对应发音。

messages.context: 当值国王是 Redros 时的吐槽
messages.text: I'm fairly sure Redros used to be a guard, and they added him to the table one day by mistake.
messages.zh: 我很确定 Redros 以前是个卫兵,是他们哪天不小心把他加进这张桌子的。
messages.raw: §fI'm fairly sure Redros used to be a guard, and they added him to the table one day by mistake.

messages.context: 当值国王是 Emmor 时的吐槽,带叹气语气词
messages.text: Emmor is the King today... sigh.

messages.context: 当值国王是 Erren 时的吐槽
messages.text: Erren keeps losing at Tic Tac Toe, but he loves the game. A brave man in a way.
messages.gloss: Tic Tac Toe 是“井字棋”,常见游戏名可直译。
messages.zh: Erren 老是输井字棋,但他很喜欢这个游戏。某种意义上也算个勇士。
messages.raw: §fErren keeps losing at Tic Tac Toe, but he loves the game. A brave man in a way.

messages.context: 当值国王是 Emkam 时的吐槽
messages.text: Emkam is funny at least. But that's about it.
messages.zh: 至少 Emkam 挺有趣的。不过也就这样了。
messages.raw: §fEmkam is funny at least. But that's about it.
§b✆§f You want me to give you §6Commissions §finstead?
messages.text: ✆ You want me to give you Commissions instead?

segments.text: You want me to give you

messages.raw: §b✆§f Are you implying that the §6King §fis incompetent?!
messages.text: ✆ Are you implying that the King is incompetent?!

messages.raw: §b✆§f I've been saying that for years!
messages.text: ✆ I've been saying that for years!

segments.text: I've been saying that for years!

messages.raw: §b✆§f If you return my §6Royal Pigeon§f, I'll give you my contact.
messages.text: ✆ If you return my Royal Pigeon, I'll give you my contact.

segments.zh: 找回来,我就把联系方式给你。
我那只宝贝的、漂亮的鸽子啊……

messages.raw: §b✆§f You don't have what I need! Nice try!
messages.text: ✆ You don't have what I need! Nice try!

segments.text: You don't have what I need! Nice try!
segments.zh: 你手上根本没有我要的东西! 想得美!

messages.raw: §fThe King made me go grocery shopping. Me! Can you believe that? He has a pair of perfectly good legs, and still, here I am.
messages.text: The King made me go grocery shopping. Me! Can you believe that? He has a pair of perfectly good legs, and still, here I am.
messages.zh: 国王居然打发我去买菜。让我去! 你敢信吗?他明明有一双好腿,结果跑腿的还是我。

messages.raw: §fI bet when I am back, they are all still sitting around that table! All day, every day! It's ludicrous!
messages.text: I bet when I am back, they are all still sitting around that table! All day, every day! It's ludicrous!
messages.zh: 我敢打赌,等我回去的时候,他们准还全都围坐在那张桌子边上! 天天如此,一天到晚! 简直荒唐!

messages.raw: §fOh, you refuse to work as well? I should have known.
messages.text: Oh, you refuse to work as well? I should have known.
messages.zh: 哦,你也不肯干活?我早该想到的。
